protocol.admin: max id across all messages in the conversation
protocol.member: max id among messages visible to that identity (broadcast, sent, or directly received)

clientBehavior: first state establishes a seen baseline for every conversation; restart resets the baseline
inactive conversation with latestMessageId above the local baseline shows a dot
active conversation and switching into it clear the dot
state stays client-side in memory; no server read receipts or persistence

verification.serverTest: conversation lists expose latestMessageId with member visibility scoping
verification.native: isolated two-conversation data dir; after injecting a message into the inactive conversation the list showed ● 第二对话 while 初始对话 stayed active
verification.web: headless browser: after injecting a message the select option became ● 第二对话; switching to it cleared the dot and loaded the message

notes: no message content is exposed by latestMessageId
formal data dir and daily instance were not modified
